name: Jeeter | 1g Quad Infused Preroll | Apple Crisp (Seasonal)
description:
Apple Crisp delivers a burst of tart green apple that immediately grabs your attention. Inspired by the sharp, candy-like bite of a green apple treat, the flavor opens bright and energetic before easing into subtle citrus sweetness and a smooth finish.

Crisp, refreshing, and full of personality, Apple Crisp is built for spontaneous plans, weekend escapes, and every summer adventure that starts with "why not?"
